rule: These are weak priors, not stereotypes. Individual variance must exceed between-country average differences.

ARCUS.kinship: Nuclear households common around port settlements; apprentices often live with master households.
ARCUS.reputation: Competence, reliability and ability to finish work carry visible status.
ARCUS.communication: Direct in work settings; personal favors often handled privately.

MIREA.kinship: Extended family and neighboring households frequently share seasonal labor.
MIREA.reputation: Being dependable in communal work matters more than conspicuous wealth.
MIREA.communication: Consensus-seeking is common but private dissent is normal.

VALD.kinship: Multigenerational households are common because winter labor and storage are shared.
VALD.reputation: Preparedness and keeping obligations through difficult seasons carry high status.
VALD.communication: People tend to understate optimism and over-prepare rather than promise easily.
